title: 第7章 三个月第8章 倾家荡产三人组
slug: 绑定生子系统后我御兽封神
content_zh:
霸天虎如今的实力不算强，但它幼小的身躯里，竟有一丝威慑众生的力量。
如宋方这样的化神期强者，竟然都被这种力量震慑了一瞬间。
宋方的脸色顿时变了。
他毫不犹豫，直接挥手，凌厉的掌风，直接朝着霸天虎袭去。
他竟是想要直接击杀霸天虎！
“宋方！你怎么敢！”一道厉喝声响了起来，一直注意着宋方举动的陈戈，瞬间拦在了他面前。
他抬手，将掌风扛了下来！
陈戈飞快地说道：“掌门，刚刚的力量，是神兽的威压！这霸天虎，有进阶神兽的潜力！”
神兽！
殿内众人的神情也都变了。
“的确，那等威压，非神兽不能有。”
“我灵心宗能有今日，全靠先祖留下的两只护宗神兽。但护宗神兽寿数将近，我灵心宗危在旦夕！若能出现新的守护神兽，可再保我灵心宗，千年荣光啊。”
“霸天虎，不能杀！”
“林颜，也不能杀。”
众人纷纷说道。
宋方冷声说道：“那林颜品格如此低劣，哪怕这霸天虎日后成了神兽，在她的言传身教下，能是什么好的？到时候，恐怕是祸不是福。”
宋方的眸底隐约闪过一丝遗憾。那陈戈的反应还是太快了一点，否则，在众人还没有反应过来时，他就先将霸天虎给击杀了，自然也就不会有后面的事情了。
林颜抱住霸天虎，眼泪汪汪：“我真的不是故意霸占霸天虎的。只是，我和小虎可能格外投缘，契约时，我的灵力突然增长了一大截，小虎的身上，更是浮现出金色纹理。我和小虎，已经不能分离了。宋长老要杀，就把我们一起杀了吧。”
“那我就成全你！”宋方想要上前。
众人纷纷将他拦住。

林颜垂眸，掩盖眸底的冷色。为了霸天虎那一瞬间散发出来的气势，她积攒着的锦鲤之力，瞬间用了大半。
这对她来说，很亏。
但是，为了过了这一关，她也顾不得了。
“林颜和霸天虎契约时，双方都有异象。这证明，他们两人天生契合。若是这霸天虎真被宋荞契约了，怕是根本不可能有进阶神兽的潜力！”陈戈缓声说道：“要我说，林颜契约霸天虎，就是天意。宋长老，当遵循天意。”
“林颜的事情另外再说。但灵心宗千年以来，都没有人契约过一只神兽，霸天虎，绝不能杀。”
“宋长老，林颜也不是罪大恶极之辈，不如，再给她一次机会。”
众人竟是纷纷帮林颜说起了话。
他们为的不是林颜，而是这有可能进阶成神兽的霸天虎！
宋方的脸色顿时阴沉了下来。
宋荞沉默地看着这一切。
她在心里叹了一口气。
男主女主，果然没有这么好杀！
她穿越的这个御兽大陆，有人族夺天地之造化，有灵兽汲天地之灵力。
初时，人族和灵兽的修行都十分艰难。
直到有人发现……如果人族修士和灵兽共同修行，则双方的修炼速度都会加快。
这个大陆，也就形成了以御兽师为主流的修行方法。
低等灵兽，中等灵兽，高等灵兽。
高等灵兽之上，便是极为少有的神兽！
如今灵心宗的两只护宗神兽，就是创派祖师寿尽之后，留下来守护宗门的。
正是因为有这两只护宗神兽在，灵心宗才有了这千年的鼎盛。

如今。
两只护宗神兽即将寿尽，宗门中却出现了一只新的具有神兽潜力的高等神兽。
content_en:
The Decepticon is not very powerful now, but in its young body, there is actually a trace of power to intimidate all living beings.
God-transformation stage powerhouses like Song Fang were shocked by this power for a moment.
Song Fang's expression suddenly changed.
He did not hesitate, waved his hand, and struck directly towards the Decepticon with the sharp wind of his palm.
He actually wanted to kill the Decepticons directly!
"Song Fang! How dare you!" A sharp shout rang out, and Chen Ge, who had been paying attention to Song Fang's actions, instantly stopped in front of him.
He raised his hand and took the wind away from his palm!
Chen Ge said quickly: "Master, the power just now was the pressure of the divine beast! This Decepticon has the potential to advance into the divine beast!"
Divine beast!
The expressions of everyone in the hall also changed.
"Indeed, no one except a divine beast can have that kind of coercion."
"Our Lingxin Sect can be what it is today thanks to the two guardian beasts left by our ancestors. However, the lifespan of the guardian beasts is approaching, and our Lingxin Sect is in danger! If a new guardian beast can appear, we can protect our Lingxin Sect's glory for thousands of years."
"Decepticons cannot be killed!"
"Lin Yan can't be killed either."
Everyone said one after another.
Song Fang said coldly: "The character of Lin Yan is so low. Even if the Decepticon becomes a mythical beast in the future, what good can he do under her words and deeds? By then, I am afraid it will be a disaster rather than a blessing."
A trace of regret flashed vaguely in Song Fang's eyes. Then Chen Ge's reaction was still a little too fast, otherwise, he would have killed the Decepticon before everyone could react, and naturally nothing would happen later.
Lin Yan hugged the Decepticon and burst into tears: "I really didn't mean to occupy the Decepticon. It's just that Xiaohu and I may have been particularly fond of each other. During the contract, my spiritual power suddenly increased a lot, and golden texture appeared on Xiaohu's body. Xiaohu and I can no longer be separated. If Elder Song wants to kill, let's kill us together."
"Then I will help you!" Song Fang wanted to step forward.
Everyone stopped him one after another.
Lin Yan lowered his eyes to cover up the cold look in his eyes. For the momentum that the Decepticons exuded at that moment, she used up most of the koi power she had accumulated in an instant.
This is a big loss for her.
However, in order to pass this level, she couldn't care less.
"When Lin Yan and the Decepticon contracted, both sides had visions. This proves that the two of them are innately compatible. If the Decepticon is really contracted by Song Qiao, I am afraid that there is no potential to advance to the divine beast!" Chen Ge said slowly: "If you ask me, Lin Yan's contract with the Decepticon is God's will. Elder Song, you should follow God's will."
"Lin Yan's matter will be discussed elsewhere. But in the Lingxin Sect's thousands of years, no one has contracted with a divine beast, the Decepticon, and must not be killed."
"Elder Song, Lin Yan is not a very evil person. Why not give her another chance."
Everyone actually spoke for Lin Yan one after another.
What they were looking for was not Lin Yan, but the Decepticon who might advance into a divine beast!
Song Fang's face suddenly darkened.
Song Qiao watched all this in silence.
She sighed inwardly.
The male protagonist and the female protagonist are indeed not so easy to kill!
In this beast-controlling continent she traveled through, there were humans taking over the creation of heaven and earth, and there were spiritual beasts taking over the spiritual power of heaven and earth.
In the beginning, the cultivation of humans and spiritual beasts was very difficult.
Until someone discovered... If human monks and spiritual beasts practice together, the speed of both parties' practice will speed up.
This continent has also formed a practice method with beast masters as the mainstream.
Low spiritual beasts, medium spiritual beasts, high spiritual beasts.
Above the high-level spiritual beasts, there are extremely rare divine beasts!
Nowadays, the two guardian beasts of Lingxin Sect are the ones who stayed to guard the sect after the founder of the sect died.
It is precisely because of the presence of these two sect-protecting beasts that the Lingxin Sect has been at its peak for thousands of years.
now.
The two sacred beasts that protect the sect are about to expire, but a new high-level sacred beast with the potential of a sacred beast appears in the sect.
